slots.name: release status
slots.sentence: "Europe has just agreed to release a massive amount of their heavily stocked Diesel Oil," Mr. Trump wrote on Truth Social. "The process will begin immediately. Thank you for your attention to this matter!"

slots.name: oil export restrictions
slots.sentence: It also agreed not to restrict oil exports, an effort to bring down the soaring price of diesel and other fuels.

slots.name: front-loaded release window
slots.sentence: This will include a "front-loaded substantial diesel release within the first 20 days by G7 members and partners," the statement said.

slots.name: release duration
slots.sentence: A joint statement from G7 leaders released by the Élysée Palace in Paris confirmed a "coordinated release" of 100 million barrels that is to begin immediately and will take place over a four-month period.

slots.name: fuel cost increase
slots.sentence: Diesel costs are up by more than $2 compared with a year ago, while gasoline is up by more than a dollar.
